notes: Medium. Round-trip a resharded chunk vault back to the exact original file tree in place: validate the index (version/chunk_size/digest/entries), reassemble each file from deduplicated content-addressed blobs in order (identical chunks stored once and shared across files), honor per-file declared sizes with short final chunks and empty (0-chunk) files, create implied nested directories, refuse path escapes, and only after full success delete the vault artifacts (blobs/ + index.json) so the directory equals the original tree exactly. The verifier executes /app/restore.py on a scratch copy of the visible vault and on hidden vaults covering heavy dedup, empty/1-byte/sub-chunk files, chunk-boundary sizes (96/192/97/95), 4-level nesting, and all-byte-value binary content, requiring diff -r exactness with no leftover artifacts. Differs from jade-shard (three-way contiguous JSON tensor shard + checksum manifest): a file-tree chunk vault with cross-file dedup and in-place artifact cleanup, verified by exact tree comparison rather than JSON equality. Rubric total 11 -> medium; reasoning_depth 2 (dedup + boundary arithmetic + ordering), hidden_case_generalization 2, quantitative_correctness 2 (byte-exact reconstruction).
